code/rust/core_contracts/src/witness_emp: Runs supplied candidate callbacks on generic IntoIterator inputs, accumulating empirical Phi delta or checking equality after repeated applications. Finite samples are documentation, not a type bound: iterator/callback may be unbounded and no budget applies. BaseType::validate is never called; empty samples yield zero-count records. NaN deltas never satisfy >0 and f64::max can discard NaN, so malformed numeric evidence can report zero violations. Hashes frame parts but omit actual sample/output/operator identity; idempotence/determinism hashes commit only IDs/schema/count, Phi hash omits extrema/full violations.
